versions.changelog: v1.0.1: Added scripts/ subdirectory with 6 core Python scripts (organize_music, dedup_music, rematch_lyrics, clean_orphan_lyrics, restore_orphan_lyrics, cleanup_empty_dirs_v2) plus scripts/README.md. Users can now install the skill and directly run the included scripts.

Initial release. Safe-by-default music library organizer with soft-delete + mandatory owner confirmation + 6-stage workflow. Includes 3 real-world scenarios (first-time org, backup merge, swap-fix) and lessons learned from 6/18-6/21 organization tasks.
